tei:titleStmt.tei:title: gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i rgyun khyer ni/rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i rgyun khyer ni/rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i rgyun khyer ni/ 1$0000300rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la// dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /

ces yan lag brgyad pa dang tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pa'i rkyen gyis rig pa chu las nya ldang gi tshul du/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyang tshul// bzhad pa'i zhal g.yas dkar zhing g.yon dmar gshe// dbus zhal mthing nag drag tu rngam zhing 'bar// spyan dgu sdang mig khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug /shangs nas hūm̐ 'byin zhal nas phaṭa sgra sgrog /rno dbal drag po'i mche ba zur gsum gtsigs// nyis khri chig stong dbu skra gyen du 'khyil// bye ba ther 'bum rdo rje'i ba spus gtams// g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs// g.yon gyi dang pos me dpung 'bar ba bsnams// g.yas kyi gnyis pas rdo rje rtse lnga 'phyar/ kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum g.yon gyi gnyis par 'khrol// tha ma'i phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril// rigs lnga'i rtse bran thod skam cod pan can// tshar gsum thod pa'i phreng ba ga shal bsnams// sbrul chen rigs bzhi phud sgra sgrog pas brgyan// rak+ta'i thig le zhag gi zo ris dang*// thal chen tshom bus rab brjid glang chen gyi// ko rlon zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gos su gyon// stag lpags sham thabs 'phyang zhing rdo rje yi// gshog pa gdengs pas bar snang khyab par 'gengs// mthing nag dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba'i sku /rdo rje khro bo nyams dgus rol pa'i yum// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing ga khro zhing sgeg /g.yas pa ut+pal 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// g.yon pa bhan dmar stob la rab brtson ma/ khro mo'i rgyan dang gzig lpags sham thabs can// bde stong sbyor bas 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// yab kyi thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad pa// ma rgad gur phub lta bu'i srog gi gor// ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems tshon gang ba// dkar gsal rdor dril rin chen rgyan cha can// de yi thugs kar rin chen cha brgyad dbus// sran ma bkas pa tsam gyi nyi ma la// rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐// yungs 'bru tsam du phra zhing 'bar ba'i mthar// srog yig 'bru dgus g.yas su bskor ba'i sgo

/rta mgrin dmar po pad+ma bhañdza'i phyag /yum dang gnyis med 'khril bas bsrung bar gyur// ces rim gyis gsal btab nas/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku /ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig /srog gi go ru shar ba dang*// snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya// zhes pas rnam pa gsal zhing nga rgyal brtan pas lha sngags la rtse gcig pas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥdzaḥhūm̐ āḥ zhes bsnyen sngags 'bru bcu bdun pa nyid gtso bor bzla zhing mthar hūm̐ gis 'od gsal du bsdu zhing phaṭa kyis thun mtshams kyi lhar langs la dge ba bsngo bar bya'o// zhes pa'ang rgyun gyi nyams len khyer bde'i ched du 'gyur med rdo rjes spel ba'o/// / smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang sems can kun// bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun zhi zhing*// rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa'i sar// 'bras bu byang chub nges par brnyes gyur cig / bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las// thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa// bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku /mi 'gyur rtag pa'i don gyi bkra shis shog / sogs bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod par bya'o//
